correctness.rationale: All radical paths have lengths one, two, or three, giving \(w+4e\) dimensions. Cubing gives exactly \(a_u b_{uv}c_v\) on each length-three path and \(q^{3e}\) free higher-path coordinates. Conditioning on outer-coordinate support yields the prescribed-fiber formula. The radical cubic-zero ideal is squarefree. Disjoint matching triples and a Kőnig vertex cover prove its codimension is \(\nu(G)\). The leading-degree calculation and uniform-mixture bound follow algebraically. Complete target enumeration over prime fields of orders two and three and independent path multiplication checks of \(64\), \(729\), and \(2048\) elements passed; the proof covers arbitrary prime powers.
